name: adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Sand'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Sand’ complements its molded one-piece construction with an understated light tan finish. Built with EVA foam, the upper features sculpted lines and a series of mapped vents throughout the midfoot and vamp for enhanced breathability. A textured footbed keeps the foot locked in place, while the contoured outsole utilizes a wavy traction pattern for optimal grip. An adidas logo is stamped under the heel.
